parameters.name: AppTags
parameters.description: The user-defined tags. You can specify multiple tags.

sub_parameters.name: TagValue
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the dedicated cluster.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A string generated by the server that serves as a request identifier for the client.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the baseline owner.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~2680071~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ReportSendEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to send the report to email and internal messages.

parameters.name: SubscribePeriod
parameters.description:
The send interval of the app usage report. Valid values:

- Weekly
- Biweekly
- Monthly

Default value: Weekly.

parameters.name: SubscribeStatus
parameters.description:
The subscription status of the app usage report. Valid values:

- UnSubscribe
- Subscribe
